name: Seed find bar with selected text on Cmd/Ctrl+F
description: Selecting text and pressing Ctrl/Cmd+F now prefills the find bar with the selection, matching browser/VSCode behavior. Handles the diff content living inside per-file shadow roots.

steps.title: Read the selection and seed the query
steps.body:
`openFind()` now reads the current text selection before opening the bar and seeds `find.query` with it.

The diff content renders inside per-file **shadow roots**, where the document-level selection retargets to the shadow host and `window.getSelection().toString()` returns empty. `readSelectionText()` falls back to Chromiums non-standard `ShadowRoot.getSelection()`, walking the registered sections until it finds the live selection. Multi-line selections are ignored since block separators break matches across lines.

The existing FindBar input reflects `find.query` and selects it on open, so the seeded text shows up highlighted and the next keystroke still replaces it.

callouts.body: Seeds the query with the selection on open, unless it already matches the existing query.
